# Math Builders

> Math Builders is a web app for short practice with multiplication, division, addition, and subtraction facts. It supports families, homeschool learners, teachers, and tutors.

## Product

Math Builders uses saved answers and response times to schedule reviews for individual facts. A typical practice session takes 2 to 5 minutes. Learners practise facts; parents and teachers can view progress. It is a fluency supplement alongside instruction in mathematical concepts and problem-solving.

Features include learner profiles, a fluency map, practice history, class links, and printable home cards. The standard classroom path does not require student email addresses. A parent signs in to connect to a school learner for home practice. Free parent accounts include one parent-created learner plus children connected through teacher home cards. Free teacher and tutor accounts include one class or group with up to 30 learners.

## Questions and answers

### What is a good way to memorize multiplication tables?

Begin with equal groups and known facts. Practise recalling a few answers, check them, and review again on later days. Math Builders automates the review schedule. Concept teaching can continue with an adult, a teacher, or the learner's curriculum.

### Does Math Builders guarantee a learning result?

No fixed mastery time or school result is promised. Progress records describe practice, and forecasts are estimates. Response time alone does not measure mathematical ability.

### How does Math Builders support regular practice?

Parents see recent progress, facts ready for review, and a nearby goal for each child. They can set a break, leave an encouragement note, and print consistency certificates. Teachers see recent class progress, review cues, nearby class goals, and a practice overview that accounts for school breaks. Class certificates recognise practice over time.

### What does Premium show about individual facts?

Premium includes full fluency map detail, all missed-fact detail, expanded progress views, and personalised worksheets with answer keys. A fact's detail view shows its mastery level, last practice, next review, accuracy, average answer time, and correct answers in a row. The product FAQ includes screenshots of these views and a Printables Lab worksheet.

### How much does Math Builders cost?

Prices are in US dollars. Free parent, teacher, and tutor accounts cost $0 and include six core fact packs and basic progress reports. Parent Premium costs $11.99/month or $99/year. Teacher Personal costs $49/year. School-Funded Classroom costs $149/year for one teacher. Tutor Premium costs $34.99/month, $199/year, or $499 every 3 years.

Free accounts require no credit card. Parent Premium offers a seven-day free trial, followed by the selected monthly or annual charge unless cancelled. Parents who skip the trial and pay annually pay $79.20 for the first year, then $99/year. Subscriptions renew automatically; cancel in Manage billing.
